title: Tibik notices
description: Fleet notices shown in the mod. Hand-edited; validated live in VS Code (draft-07). Server-side eligibility (enabled / schedule / conditions) is authoritative; the client only renders, acks, and dismisses.

$schema.description: Path to this schema. Enables editor validation; ignored at runtime and never served to clients.

notices.description: Notices, evaluated top-to-bottom (array order breaks severity ties).

id.description: Stable dismissal / vote key. Never reuse an id. A NEW poll (fresh votes) needs a new id; bumping revision only re-shows to non-voters.

enabled.description: Instant kill switch, independent of the schedule.

severity.description: Visual loudness (maps to a theme colour). NOT a content category - a promo is just an 'info'.
enumDescriptions: Red fill; highest emphasis + can outrank the built-in banners.

surfaces.description: Where it may appear (omit -> ["banner"]). banner = expanded panel; bubble = collapsed disguise icon. Both surfaces render the notice's action buttons (incl. poll vote choices) plus a dismiss, so a poll is answerable on either. A bubble only has room for a few icons: more than 3 actions degrades it to a teaser whose tap expands the panel.

dismissible.description: Whether a dismiss (X) button is offered on the notice. Default true.

revision.description: Bump to re-show a notice users already dismissed. For a poll, a bump re-shows to NON-voters only; it does not reset votes (use a new id for fresh opinions).

starts_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC; hidden before this instant.

ends_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC; hidden after this instant.

conditions.description: Server-side targeting (old clients can't honor these, so the server filters). All AND-ed.

mod_version_min.description: Minimum mod version inclusive (e.g. "v1.0.26"), or null.

mod_version_max.description: Maximum mod version inclusive (the "wait for the Tibik update" case), or null.

text.description: Localized text; 'en' is the required floor, any other locale key is an allowed string. The client picks the active locale with a fallback chain.

ack.description: Post-vote confirmation for a poll (localized), used for any chosen action lacking its own `ack`. Keep it neutral (thank for the feedback, not the opinion) so it reads fine over any choice; omit to use the mod's bundled default.

actions.description: Buttons. A `vote` action makes this notice a POLL: its id is the recorded choice, one immutable vote per account (no change / no retract - a new poll id gets fresh opinions). Vote actions in one notice form a single-choice group. `copy` puts text on the clipboard.

id.description: Stable per-notice button id. For a vote it IS the recorded choice value - never reuse across choices.

kind.description: copy = clipboard; vote = single-choice ballot; link = open URL (future).
enumDescriptions: Copies `copy` to the clipboard on tap.
Records a one-per-account ballot; the id is the stored choice.

icon.description: IconLoader glyph name from the game's UI atlas (e.g. UiMiscCheck, UiMiscX, UiMiscHeart, UiMenuCopy).

ack.description: This choice's post-tap confirmation (localized), overriding the notice-level `ack`. The code has no notion of a choice's polarity - this text carries all the tone (e.g. a downvote's 'Sorry to hear it').
